**-Protective mask MUST be worn at all times at the competition venue.**

venue.name: [刈谷市産業振興センター (Kariya Industrial Promotion Center)](https://www.city.kariya.lg.jp/shisetsu/sangyo_keizai/1005633.html)
venue.address: 〒448-0027 刈谷市相生町1丁目1番地6(1-1-6, Aioicho, Kariya, Aichi)

items.information:
## COVID-19の感染再拡大に伴って首都圏を中心とする緊急事態宣言が延長され、本大会の開催日である8月28日が対象期間となったため、Tokai Summer AM 2021および Tokai Summer PM 2021の開催を中止いたします。

**東海夏AM2021 (以下、AM大会) と東海夏PM2021 (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA Competition Requirements Policy で定められているところの「Twin Competitions」となります。**
このため、いずれかの大会の申込みのみが承認されます。
両方に申込んだ場合は、申込日時が早い方を受理し、申込日時が遅い方は無効とします。悪しからずご了承ください。

なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。

* AM大会は、3x3x3 キューブと 2x2x2 キューブの2種目です。
* PM大会は、3x3x3 キューブの1種目のみです。

COVID-19対策のため、入場者数を制限します。**事前承認のない見学はお断りします。**見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛にメールを送ってください。
____
## Due to the re-expansion of COVID-19 infection, the state of emergency centered on the Tokyo metropolitan area was extended, and the target period was August 28, the date of this tournament, so Tokai Summer AM 2021 and Tokai Summer PM 2021 Will be canceled.

**Tokai Summer AM 2021 (AM) and Tokai Summer PM 2021 (PM) are "Twin Competitions" defined in the WCA Competition Requirements Policy.**
Therefore, you can register either of these competitions. If you register for both competitions, the earlier one will only be recieved, and the later one will be rejected. 

Please make sure that the events for AM and PM are different. 

* AM event holds the 3x3x3 cube and the 2x2x2 cube.    
* PM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 cube.   

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as COVID-19 countermeasure. If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, **please be sure to email the organization team in advance.** or we will not permit your entrance.!

items.information:
(HR)

Osijek Re-Open 2021 je petnaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska plaćaju 2/3 pune cijene kotizacije.

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

--------------

(EN)

Osijek Re-Open 2021 is the 15th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia pay 2/3 of the full registration fee.

For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled.

# The date for this competition has changed to August 20-21, 2021. Please familiarize yourself with the [Safety Plan] (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgSyWUwrL1MkixikzJqiZXodSBejV2S39T_18PCm5-E/edit).

1. If COVID-19 cases drop to below 10 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue as announced.
2. If COVID-19 cases are between 10 and 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue, but all attendees (spectators and competitors) must show either proof of full vaccination (2 weeks since last shot of 1 or 2 dose series) or have a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the beginning of the event, or after 8:00am Eastern on Monday, August 16th, 2021. There are no exceptions. 
3. If COVID-19 cases are greater than 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will not continue and we will either reschedule or cancel at that time.


# Maximum one spectator per competitor. 
## This competition’s registration and waitlist is full.


We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. We will have two special unofficial events as well as the option to have a day at HersheyPark on Sunday with all of your friends.

This is the state championship for Pennsylvania, however, anyone can attend. All state champion titles are unofficial and are **not** recognized by the World Cube Association or CubingUSA. For more information on state champion eligibility, see the [PA Title eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14358-pa-title-eligibility).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations
Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition.
Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.

Day 1 Events: Pyraminx, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, 6x6, 7x7, Sq-1, FMC
Day 2 Events: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One Handed

**This competition is sponsored by TheCubicle!**
Visit the [Sponsor/Vending](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14359-sponsor-vending) tab for more information.

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

This competition will take place on Saturday. There will be an identical competition also occuring on Sunday, which you can find [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PikesPeakSummerB2021)

This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the *Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab*  before registering.

Due to indoor event guidance in Colorado, the competitor limit for this competition is 50 competitors. Competitors are being asked to bring only one spectator maximum to the competition, and if possible, to attend alone.

items.name: Cubes Masters Zhytomyr 2021
items.information:
Новини стосовно швидкубінгу в Україні публікуються на нашій сторінці в [Телеграм](https://t.me/cubing_info).
Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ).

На змаганнях буде проведена неофіційна дисципліна — розв’язання кубика 3х3х3 для дітей до 12 років.
Записатись на цю дисципліну можна буде на змаганнях, але дуже бажаний попередній запис за телефоном +380 63 324 7832.
Вартість участі в неофіційній дисципліні — 30 грн.

Будь ласка, ознайомтесь з інформацією на вкладці COVID-19 для підвищення безпеки на змаганнях.

***

News regarding Ukrainian Speedcubing are published on our page in [Telegram](https://t.me/cubing_info).
Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ).

At the competition an unofficial event will be held — solving of 3x3x3 Cube for kids under 12 years.
Signing up for this event will be possible at competition, but it is highly recommended to sign up in advance by phone +380 63 324 7832.
Participation fee in unofficial event — 30 UAH (~$1).

Please review the COVID-19 tab for information regarding steps taken to increase the competitor safety at this competition.
